in_marathi.name: Arhita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Pledge, Bond, Promise
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arhita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit word ‘arhita’ which means ‘one to whom a debt is owed’. It is derived from the root ‘arh’ meaning ‘to deserve’. This name signifies the concept of giving and receiving, symbolizing a deep bond or commitment. It is often given to a child born into a family where there is a strong sense of duty and responsibility.
